name: XG-82-2L
subtitle: Industrial - Switch
description: A Layer 2 managed PoE switch with 8 Gigabit ports, 2x 2.5G SFP uplinks, 240W PoE budget, 20 Gbps switching capacity, and MSTP/QoS/ERPS/SNMP management in a DIN-rail aluminium enclosure.

hardware.value:
Option 1: 2 Screw Terminal block Option 2: Spring
Loaded 2 Pin Terminal block and DC Jack

software.value: Compatible with IEEE 802.3AF/AT compliant Powered Devices (PD). Wire-speed forwarding. MAC self-learning and aging. IEEE802.3X Full-duplex and backpressure for half-duplex mode
MAC Manage, Strom Control, Traffic Monitoring, DHCP Snooping

QoS Basic, QoS Advance (802.1p)
Diagnostics: Ping Tool, Cable diagnostics
Configuration Utility: Import and Export Configuration backup
Web, CLI (Console Port, Telnet, SSH), SNMP V1/V2, Support trap: cold start, warm start, link down and link up
POE configuration, POE scheduling management, etc.

physical.value: 200 x 120 x 55 mm (W x L x H)

use_cases.title: Enterprise Surveillance & Security Networks
use_cases.desc: Ideal for large CCTV deployments, enabling centralized management of IP cameras, PoE-powered devices, and optimized video traffic through QoS and VLAN support.

use_cases.title: Smart Campus & Enterprise Network Management
use_cases.desc: Suitable for offices, campuses, and commercial buildings requiring managed switching, traffic prioritization, and secure segmentation for access points, IP phones, and endpoints.

use_cases.title: Industrial Network Control & Redundancy
use_cases.desc: Can be deployed in factories and utility environments where Layer 2 management, ERPS redundancy, IGMP snooping, and network diagnostics are essential for uninterrupted operations.
